title: ScndTelephPrvdOtbdDtl - Tooling API
description: Represents the outbound SIP routing configuration for a secondary telephony provider in Agentforce Contact Center BYOC. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

CustomHeader.description: Custom SIP headers for outbound calls.

DeveloperName.description: Unique name of the object in the API.

HostConfig.description: Key-value pair of IP address and port. You can specify a maximum of 5 entries.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
MasterLabel.description: User interface label for the outbound details for the secondary telephony provider. This internal label doesn’t get translated.

OutboundAuthEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OutboundAuthEnabled.description: Indicates whether outbound authentication is enabled (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

SecondaryTelephonyProviderId.description: ID of the associated secondary telephony provider. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access ScndTelephPrvdOtbdDtl, you must have the Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set assigned.
